svg.title: Disjunctive deduction: affirm one, exclude the others / הקש מחלק
svg.desc: Chapter 7, Hebrew pp105–107, English pp106–108. Given exactly one of the alternatives, establishing one excludes all the others. The selected disjunctive fork, solid right node and crossed left branch are preserved under one uniform transform. A new arrow runs from the established right alternative to the rejected left alternative. It marks the direction of reasoning, not a temporal or causal process. Two branches illustrate a potentially larger exhaustive and mutually exclusive partition. An inclusive or does not license this inference. This is a directional companion, not a sixth deduction family.
